skip_reason: The desktop-guardian skill fundamentally requires macOS (Tahoe or later), Hammerspoon (a macOS-only automation framework), Accessibility permissions, and live GUI desktop interaction (window management, dialog clicking, app monitoring). None of these can be replicated in a Linux-based Docker container. This violates the banned categories of 'Multi-modal perception (GUI, images, video, OCR, browser DOM layout)' and 'Host-level hardware access'. The skill's core functionality is inseparable from a live macOS desktop environment.
